changelog: WAJIB UPDATE: versi ini memakai database baru hasil migrasi — update aplikasi agar lagu, playlist, dan fitur sosial tetap sinkron
Migrasi database dan penyimpanan media ke sistem baru, termasuk seluruh data lagu, playlist, dan sosial
Mode gelap: baris Teruskan, sheet edit postingan/Reels, bar balasan dan sheet opsi chat private, baris pemilih audio, chip GIF, dan chip buat Story kini terbaca jelas
Mode gelap: border kartu chat, chip anggota grup, chip filter feed, dan bar perekam suara kini selaras
Mode gelap: 15 latar bottom sheet (mulai percakapan, opsi chat, buat grup, info/edit/anggota/opsi grup, mute, GIF, tambah lagu ke playlist, history, library, profil, viewer story) kini gelap solid
Mode gelap: kolom caption repost Story dan tombol buat postingan feed kini terbaca jelas
Bahasa: layar edit lagu, upload lagu, edit profil, unduhan, favorit, buat playlist, edit playlist, dan detail playlist kini sepenuhnya mengikuti bahasa aktif
Bahasa: dialog dan notifikasi di library, pemutar, pencarian, dan tombol tema kini mengikuti bahasa aktif
Bahasa: teks error saat profil gagal dimuat kini mengikuti bahasa aktif
Bahasa: pilihan genre di upload dan edit lagu, serta tombol Muat Lagi kini mengikuti bahasa aktif
Tombol +Post dan +Reels di profil sosial kini terbaca jelas di mode gelap, selaras dengan tombol Edit Profil dan +Story
Perbaikan simpan playlist agar tetap tersimpan dengan benar
changelog_en: UPDATE REQUIRED: this version uses the new database from the migration — update the app so songs, playlists, and social features stay in sync
Migration of the database and media storage to the new system, including all songs, playlists, and social data
Dark mode: forward rows, the post/Reels edit sheet, the private chat reply bar and options sheet, audio picker rows, GIF chips, and story creation chips are now clearly readable
Dark mode: chat card borders, group member chips, feed filter chips, and the voice recorder bar are now consistent

Dark mode: 15 bottom sheet backgrounds (start conversation, chat options, create group, group info/edit/members/options, mute, GIF, add song to playlist, history, library, profile, story viewer) are now solid dark
Dark mode: the story repost caption field and the feed create-post button are now clearly readable
Language: the edit song, upload song, edit profile, downloads, favorites, create playlist, edit playlist, and playlist detail screens now fully follow the active language
Language: library dialogs and notifications, player, search, and the theme toggle now follow the active language
Language: the error text when the profile fails to load now follows the active language
Language: genre choices in song upload and edit, and the Load More button now follow the active language
The +Post and +Reels buttons on the social profile are now clearly readable in dark mode, matching the Edit Profile and +Story buttons
Fixed playlist saving so saved playlists stay saved correctly
